content_sections.heading: CARI Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the CARI Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download CARI Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: CARI Recruitment 2026 - Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: A total of 2 vacancies are available - 1 for Consultant (Ayush disciplines) and 1 for Junior Research Fellow (Pharmacology).

content_sections.heading: CARI Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Consultant (Ayush disciplines): BAMS BHMS/BSMS and min 5 years experience in research OR Post-graduate Degree in Pharmacognosy/M. Pharm (Ay)/MS Natural Products/M.Sc. in Botany/Medicinal plants/Bio Technology/Life Sci. from a recognized University Institution with minimum of 5 years research experience. Junior Research Fellow (Pharmacology): Post Graduate Degree in M. Pharm/M.V. Sc/M.S (Pharm.). in Pharmacology/Toxicology, MSc life Science (Zoology/Biotechnology) from recognized university/ Institute.

content_sections.heading: CARI Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Consultant (Ayush disciplines): Maximum age 64 years. Junior Research Fellow (Pharmacology): Maximum age 35 years. To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

content_sections.heading: CARI Recruitment 2026 - Salary / Stipend
content_sections.text: Consultant (Ayush disciplines): Rs. 50,000/- per Month consolidated Junior Research Fellow (Pharmacology): Rs. 37,000/- + 30% HRA

content_sections.heading: Walk-In Procedure
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to attend the walk-in interview for CARI Various Posts Recruitment 2026 should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before attending the interview. Candidates must report at the venue as per the reporting time mentioned in the notification. Carry all original documents along with one set of self-attested photocopies such as ID proof, educational certificates, experience certificates (if required), and category certificate (if applicable). Bring the duly filled application form if required in the notification. Verify eligibility criteria before attending the interview. Candidates are advised to reach the venue well in advance to complete registration formalities. Keep extra passport-size photographs for submission if required.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to attend the walk-in interview for CARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview for the Consultant post is on 19 September 2026, and for the Junior Research Fellow post, it is on 8 September 2026. Candidates must report at the venue by 10:00 AM for registration.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in CARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 2 vacancies announced for the Consultant (Ayush disciplines) and Junior Research Fellow (Pharmacology) positions.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: For the Consultant post, candidates need BAMS BHMS/BSMS with a minimum of 5 years of research experience, or a Post-graduate Degree in Pharmacognosy/M. Pharm (Ay)/MS Natural Products/M.Sc. in Botany/Medicinal plants/Bio Technology/Life Sci. with 5 years of research experience.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the Junior Research Fellow position?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Junior Research Fellow (Pharmacology) position is 35 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Consultant post?
faq.answer: The selected candidate for the Consultant (Ayush disciplines) post will receive a consolidated salary of Rs. 50,000/- per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these CARI posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the CARI recruitment will involve a Written Test and/or Interview.

faq.question: Q7. Where is the walk-in interview venue for CARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview will be held at Central Ayurveda Research Institute, Kolkata, 4-CN Block, Sector-V, Bidhannagar, Kolkata 700091.

faq.question: Q8. Do I need to pay any application fee for CARI Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q9. What documents should I carry for the walk-in interview?
faq.answer: Candidates must carry original testimonials for verification, along with self-attested copies of certificates supporting age and qualification, and two recent passport-size photographs.

faq.question: Q10. Is there any age relaxation for reserved categories?
faq.answer: The official notification does not explicitly mention age relaxation for reserved categories. Candidates are advised to refer to the detailed notification for any such provisions.
